def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_space = bins - item
    valid_bins = remaining_space >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    current_utilization = bins - remaining_space + item  # This is equivalent to bins - (bins - item) but only for valid bins
    # For valid bins, compute log(ratio of current utilization to item size)
    # Avoid zero or negative values in log argument
    utilization_ratio = np.where(current_utilization > 0, current_utilization / item, 0)
    valid_ratio = utilization_ratio > 0
    priorities[valid_bins & valid_ratio] = np.log(utilization_ratio[valid_bins & valid_ratio])
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.

    mask = bins >= item
    return np.where(mask, -(bins - item), -np.inf)
